text: Analyse how the extract from The Man Who Fell to Earth constructs meaning, including the specific
representations of individuals/groups/events/places, through the following technical elements:
• camera shots, angles, movement and composition
• sound
• mise-en-scène
• editing.
Extract: The Man Who Fell to Earth (episode 1, ‘Hallo Spaceboy’, 2022, dir. Kurtzman) [25]
Section B: Media contexts
Answer one question from Section B.
You should make references to at least one case study in your answer.
EITHER
Explain why synergies between different media products are beneficial to media producers. [25]
OR
Analyse the ways in which local and national audiences are targeted differently. [25]
